## 0.11.0

### Removed

- `MessageDetails.AltinnCorrespondenceId` (`GetMessageAsync`): use
  `MessageDetails.Altinn.CorrespondenceId` instead. The acceptance response's
  `MessageStatus.AltinnCorrespondenceId` is unchanged.

## 0.10.0

### Added

- `MessageDetails.Altinn.ExternalReferences` (`GetMessageAsync`): the correspondence's external
  references as Altinn reports them now, in Altinn's order; empty when there are none. They include
  the references you sent and the ones Altinn adds:
  - `DialogportenDialogId`: the dialog Altinn creates for the correspondence. Altinn adds it in the
    background, so it can be missing for a while after `Created`; it's normally there once
    `Altinn.Status` is `Published`. To make a later message to the same recipient a transmission in
    that dialog, send it with `WithExternalReference(ExternalReferenceType.DialogportenDialogId, …)`
    and a `DialogportenTransmissionType`.
  - `DialogportenTransmissionId`: Altinn has created the transmission.

  The values are read live from Altinn and never stored.

## 0.9.0

### Changed

The API now returns `400` (thrown as `KommunikasjonApiException`) with a validation error for these
inputs, which Altinn rejects. Before, it accepted the message and later ended it as `DeadLetter` with
`AltinnRejected`:

- An external reference of type `DialogportenTransmissionId`. Altinn sets it after creating a
  transmission and never accepts it on creation. The enum value remains, so existing code compiles.
- A `DialogportenDialogId` that isn't a non-empty GUID (Altinn error 1048).
- A `DialogportenTransmissionType` that isn't a transmission type by name (`Information`, `Acceptance`,
  `Rejection`, `Request`, `Alert`, `Decision`, `Submission`, `Correction`, any case) or number
  (`1`–`8`). Values Altinn's parser also tolerates, such as `" Information"`, `"01"` or
  `"Information,Acceptance"`, are rejected too.
- More than one `DialogportenTransmissionType` (1052), or one without a `DialogportenDialogId` in the
  same request (1053).
- A `language` other than `nb`, `nn` or `en` (1023). Lowercase is still required.
- A body containing the NUL character U+0000 (1003). Line breaks, tabs and other control characters
  are still accepted.

A `DialogportenDialogId` Altinn or Dialogporten can't match (unknown dialog, other service owner or
recipient) still ends as `AltinnRejected`.

## 0.8.0

### Changed

- The API now returns `400` (thrown as `KommunikasjonApiException`) with a validation error on the
  title for obvious markup that Altinn rejects as not plain text (Altinn error 1002), instead of
  accepting the message and later ending it as `DeadLetter` with `AltinnRejected`: HTML tags and autolinks (`<b>`, `<ola@example.no>`),
  character references (`&`), Markdown headings, links, strikethrough and thematic breaks
  (`# Heading`, `[link](https://…)`, `~~old~~`, `---`). Ordinary text such as `R&D`,
  `Sak <2026/123>` or `#1 prioritet` is accepted. Rarer Markdown that Altinn also rejects (for example
  `H~2~O`) can still end as `AltinnRejected`.
- Titles containing control characters, including line breaks and tabs, are rejected with `400`.
  Send a single-line title.

## 0.7.0

The client no longer validates message content; the API does, and returns `400` with problem details
(thrown as `KommunikasjonApiException`). The rules live in one place, so a client version can't
reject what the API accepts or let through what it rejects. Invalid input is now reported by the API
rather than as `ArgumentException` before sending.

### Changed

- `SendMessageAsync` sends the request as given. Missing or empty idempotent keys, unknown purposes,
  external references, attachment count, size, type, file name, display name, expiration and
  `attachmentMetadata` count are checked by the API (`400`). The client still throws `ArgumentException`
  for what it can't send: a null request or attachment, an attachment without a file name or with a
  malformed content type (no longer `FormatException`), or display names or expirations set both on `MessageAttachment` and in `AttachmentMetadata`.
- `CreateMessageRequestFactory.ToOrganization` and `WithExternalReference` no longer check their
  values; `CreateSubscriptionAsync` no longer checks `purpose`.
- The stub no longer validates content either; test invalid input against the API. It still requires an
  idempotent key.
- Attachment file names are sent as `filename*` only, so any name reaches the API. The API now also
  rejects file names Altinn rejects: `< > : " | ? *` and reserved Windows names before the first dot
  (`CON`, `PRN`, `AUX`, `NUL`, `COM1`–`COM9`, `LPT1`–`LPT9`, any case, such as `CON.pdf`). Before,
  these were accepted and the message later ended as `DeadLetter`. `CONSOLE.pdf`, `Vedtak æøå.pdf`
  and `a;b.pdf` are still accepted.

### Removed

- `AttachmentRules` and `ExternalReferenceRules`. The limits are listed in the README.

## 0.6.2

### Added

- The generated queue GET (`QueueMessageDetails`) includes optional `error`, the stored latest
  processing error with Altinn's reason, as the consumer GET returns it.

## 0.6.1

### Added

- The generated queue GET (`QueueMessageDetails`) includes optional `attachmentBlobIds`, the
  attachments' storage IDs, while a message is `Queued` or `DeadLetter`.

## 0.6.0

### Added

- Optional attachment expiration: `MessageAttachment.ExpirationInDays` (an `init` property, so existing
  code is unaffected), sent as `attachmentMetadata[].expirationInDays` and passed to Altinn, which
  expires the attachment that many days after publication. Allowed range `AttachmentRules.MinExpirationInDays`
  (14, Altinn's production minimum) to `AttachmentRules.MaxExpirationInDays` (730); omit it for Altinn's
  default. Validated client-side, and part of the idempotent submission like display names.

## 0.5.0

### Added

- Optional `CreateMessageRequest.Summary` (1–255 characters, plain text), passed to Altinn as the
  correspondence's `messageSummary`. Set it with `ToOrganization(..., summary: "...")`. The summary is
  part of the idempotent submission: resending a key with a changed or removed summary returns 409.

### Changed

- **Breaking:** `CreateMessageRequestFactory.ToOrganization` now requires `idempotentKey` (a non-empty
  `Guid`) and `language`. It no longer generates a key or defaults to `nb`. Pass a key derived from
  your own data and the content's language, e.g.
  `ToOrganization(purpose, orgnr, title, body, sak.MeldingId, "nb")`. `notification` moved after the
  new `summary` parameter; pass it by name.

### Removed

- `CreateMessageRequestFactory.DefaultLanguage`; pass the language explicitly.

## 0.4.3

### Changed

- Refresh generated queue endpoint documentation.

## 0.4.2

### Added

- The generated OpenAPI contract for `GET /api/queue/{id}` includes live, body-free Altinn status across purposes
  with `Queue.Manage` alone. Lookup failures appear in `altinnProblem` alongside queue metadata,
  with bounded diagnostics and redacted person identifiers. The queue list never calls Altinn.
- `IKommunikasjonAdapter` is unchanged; it does not expose queue operations.
- The generated queue GET now returns `QueueMessageDetails` instead of `QueueMessage`. Queue
  endpoints are admin-only and may change; the supported consumer adapter and message contract
  are unchanged, so this operator-only contract update is released as a patch.
- Consumer message reads still require the stored purpose's Read or Write role.

## 0.4.1

### Added

- Message submission and queue filtering accept the reserved `load-test` purpose. Submission
  requires `Messages.LoadTest.Write` and explicitly enabled non-production acceptance. These
  messages are always simulated and cannot subscribe to Altinn events.

## 0.4.0

### Changed

- Breaking: Altinn correspondence submission and reads move from `/api/meldinger` to
  `/api/messages/altinn`. The old routes are removed; update direct API callers alongside the API.
- The generated client now uses `Api.Messages.Altinn` instead of `Api.Meldinger`.
  `IKommunikasjonAdapter` keeps its interface and uses the new routes for JSON, multipart and reads.
- The retry policy follows the new submission route; other non-idempotent requests remain excluded.

## 0.3.0

Unknown and reserved recipients end in their own final status instead of `DeadLetter`.

### Added

- `MessageState.RecipientCommunicationOptedOut`: Altinn rejected a person reserved against digital
  communication (KRR, error `1030`). Final: nothing was created, the body and attachments are removed
  and the message is never retried; `Error` keeps Altinn's reason.
- `MessageState.RecipientNotFound`: Altinn could not find the recipient (error `1029`). Final, as above.
- `MessageFailure.AltinnRecipientNotFound`, and per-state counts `RecipientCommunicationOptedOut` and
  `RecipientNotFound` in `QueueStateCounts`.

### Changed

- A message to a person reserved in KRR now ends as `RecipientCommunicationOptedOut` (still with
  `AltinnRecipientReserved`) rather than `DeadLetter`. Handle both new states as final, and send a new
  key once the recipient can receive the message.

## 0.2.1

### Changed

Description update

## 0.2.0

Breaking: one call reads a message's status together with its live Altinn details, matching the API's
merged `GET /api/meldinger/{id}`.

### Added

- `IKommunikasjonAdapter.GetMessageAsync`, returning `MessageDetails`: Kommunikasjon's status and latest
  submission error at the root, and the correspondence read live from Altinn under `Altinn` (`null` when
  there is none, for example while queued, simulated or after a rejection). Returns `null` for unknown
  messages. When Altinn cannot be read it throws `KommunikasjonApiException` (`502`, with
  `AltinnErrorCode`, or `503`) rather than returning the message without details; retry the read, not the
  submission.

### Changed

- The stub's messages are `Simulated` with `Altinn` set to `null`, like simulated messages in the API. It
  no longer returns dummy correspondence details.
- Updated `Microsoft.Kiota.Bundle` to 2.1.2 and `Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience` to 10.10.0.

### Removed

- `GetMessageStatusAsync` and `GetCorrespondenceDetailsAsync`; use `GetMessageAsync`. The generated
  `Meldinger[id].Detaljer` request builder is gone too, because the API no longer has
  `GET /api/meldinger/{id}/detaljer`.

## 0.1.0

First stable release of the client. It contains the changes from the 0.1.0 prereleases below.
No changes since 0.1.0-alpha4.

## 0.1.0-alpha4

### Added

- `KommunikasjonApiException` and `GetKommunikasjonProblemDetails()` (`KommunikasjonProblemDetails`:
  title, detail, status, validation errors, trace ID, Altinn error code).

### Changed

- Failed requests (adapter and `KommunikasjonApiClient`) now throw `KommunikasjonApiException`, whose
  message names the HTTP method and URL, the status code, and the problem details the API returned
  (title, detail, validation errors and trace ID), or the response body (truncated to 4096
  characters) when it isn't a problem document. Before, the message was the generic
  `Exception of type '…ValidationProblemDetails' was thrown.`, validation errors were only reachable as
  untyped nodes, and the body was lost for status codes the API spec doesn't declare.
  **Breaking:** `catch (ProblemDetails)` / `catch (ValidationProblemDetails)` no longer match; the
  generated exception is now the `InnerException`. `catch (ApiException)` and `ResponseStatusCode`
  work as before.

## 0.1.0-alpha3

### Added

- External references: `CreateMessageRequest.ExternalReferences` (`ExternalReferenceRequest` with the
  string enum `ExternalReferenceType`), `CreateMessageRequestFactory.WithExternalReference` and
  client-side validation in `ExternalReferenceRules` (at most 10, values 1–1000 characters). Mapped to
  Altinn's correspondence external references.
- Attachment display names: optional `MessageAttachment.DisplayName`, sent as `attachmentMetadata` in
  the multipart payload (matched by order) and shown in Altinn instead of the file name.
  `AttachmentRules.MaxDisplayNameLength` (255).
- The stub resolves `GetMessageStatusAsync` and `GetCorrespondenceDetailsAsync` by message ID or by
  idempotent key. The API is expected to support lookup by idempotent key in a later release.

## 0.1.0-alpha2

### Added

- Kiota-generated `KommunikasjonApiClient` for the Kommunikasjon `/api` surface.
- `IKommunikasjonAdapter`: send messages (JSON or multipart with PDF attachments), read status and
  correspondence details, manage subscriptions.
- `AddKommunikasjonClient`: base URL derived from the host environment and
  `KommunikasjonEnvironment` (`Production`, `Dev`, `Local`, `Stub`), standard resilience (retries
  `POST /api/meldinger` thanks to the idempotent key) and a `Kommunikasjon` health check.
- `Stub` environment with an in-memory adapter returning dummy data.
